svg.title: How the seven contracts refer to each other
svg.desc: The context C01 is referenced by the selection C03, the decision packet C04 and the action proposal C05. The selection is referenced by the packet. The packet is referenced by the proposal. A delegation C06 is bound to an exact proposal or to a bounded class. An execution receipt C07 references one proposal and one grant. Evidence records C02 are referenced, by exact version, from the selection, the packet, the proposal, the delegation and the receipt.
